A1.method_note: Verbatim (art_jR6Pyy3W9xum:src/gen5.py): return {l: base["S"][l].norm(dim=-1) * r_at(l) for l in V_BLOCKS} | ratio = {l: float((n_bf[l] / ban[l].clamp(min=1e-6)).mean()) for l in V_BLOCKS} \ | if ban[V_BLOCKS[0]].numel() == n_bf[V_BLOCKS[0]].numel() else None ; (art_jR6Pyy3W9xum:src/analysis_c.py): rs = [r for r in rows if r["task"] == t and r["arm"] in ("PN_a1", "PN_a2") and r.get("unit_ratio")] | ratios = [float(np.mean(list(r["unit_ratio"].values()))) for r in rs] | ur[t] = {"banfree_over_ban_mean": float(np.mean(ratios)) if ratios else None, "n": len(ratios),. So each PN row (sample) stores, per block l in 12-23, the MEAN OVER TASK-SPECIFICATION POSITIONS of the per-position ratio ||h_l,pos|| * r_Q(l) / ban_l,pos; the n of unit_ratio.json counts PN rows (PN_a1 + PN_a2 samples: 50 + 50 on the five decisive tasks, 30 + 30 elsewhere), each first averaged over the 12 blocks. The ban-free unit does not depend on the plan-noise direction, so the 100 rows share few distinct values (one per prompt wording) and n is not a count of independent measurements. Table 174 (art_mgek9PfVBNbh:tables/dose_units.csv, from art_SHaWv77P1XCI:results/units.json ratio_mean_nfree_over_mean_n) is a ratio of mean norms over positions and blocks. A mean of ratios is not a ratio of means: E[a/b] exceeds E[a]/E[b] when the ban norm b varies across positions and is uncorrelated with a (Jensen), which is why the knob experiment's mean ratio is larger on every decisive task (kth smallest 1.39 against 0.97).

A2.rule: Fixed before computing: per task and per definition, (1) Holm-adjusted minimum over alpha 1 and 2 of the two-sided Fisher p at nominally matched alpha < 0.01, and (2) at the bracket (bf16 alpha 2 against FP8 alpha 1) the bf16 realised dose is at least 1.0 FP8 ban unit under both dose definitions and the bf16 share is no higher than the FP8 share. The tag 'did NOT replicate in bf16 at the population level' needs the rule under both share definitions; under one only the tag reads 'not established'.
